Aditya / team — quick triage notes from infra:

What we see
- Correlated spike in p99 and response time around 07:44–08:05 PDT across three GPU nodes in the us-west pool.
- Autoscaler logs show repeated allocate/deallocate cycles for that pool during the window; there are stretched scheduling pauses of ~300–600ms on GpuType-X nodes.
- No obvious 5xx spike on the API gateway layer, most timeouts are client-side retries and downstream tokenization queueing.

Hypothesis
- Kernel scheduling delay on GpuType-X under high fragmentation + a less-robust batch-splitting path. This causes periodic stalls and increased service-time variance.

Short-term mitigations (we can enact now)
- Route BrightCart to the higher-concurrency compatible variant (variant-c) to lower per-request queueing (will increase cost slightly).
- Prewarm KV cache for the top 20 prefixes we identified in the provided logs.
- Disable a new kernel optimization rollout that touched the batch splitter in us-west for the moment (rollback pending).

I've attached a short trace and the autoscaler snippet. I'll post fuller traces to the Drive folder.
